title: Dental PPO Plans Certificate Provision: Waiting-Period Credit on Requested Estimates
content:
**Provision.** On a pre-treatment estimate requested anew under the Dental PPO Plans (a requested estimate), the months credited toward its waiting period follow the person's earlier coverage:
(a) when the plan credits prior coverage month for month and the person has an earlier DHMO enrollment, the estimate credit is the calendar months from the month that DHMO coverage took effect through the month it ended, both months counted (DHMO coverage always takes effect on the first of a month);
(b) when the plan credits prior coverage month for month, no such DHMO enrollment exists, and the enrollment shows documented prior coverage months whose prior coverage end date is no more than 63 calendar days before the coverage effective date, the estimate credit is those documented months;
(c) otherwise no months are credited.

The months credited shorten the waiting period, never below zero, and so decide the estimated patient cost on such an estimate.

The person's earlier DHMO enrollment is the person's own terminated enrollment in Cascade's Prepaid Dental HMO Plans, matched by name and date of birth, that ended on the day before the Dental PPO enrollment's coverage effective date (a move from the DHMO with no break in coverage). The person's DHMO services are read only from that enrollment's own service records, never from another enrollment of the same subscriber.

**Plans.** Value 1000, Classic 1250, Plus 1500, Premier 2000 and Elite 2500 credit prior coverage month for month; Preventive 750 credits none. The 63-day gap is the same on every plan.

### Condition table
| Month-for-month plan | Earlier DHMO enrollment | Documented months ending within 63 days | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Either | DHMO calendar months |
| Yes | No | Yes | Documented months |
| Yes | No | No | None |
| No | Either | Either | None |

### Example (hypothetical)
DHMO coverage from 1 April to 31 October, Dental PPO coverage effective 1 November, 12-month major waiting period: 7 months are credited, leaving 5 months; an estimate issued on 1 April of the next year meets the shortened waiting period, one issued on 31 March does not.
